dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted scenario valuation (rNPV) with time discounting at a 15% systematic-risk cost of equity; four end-state scenarios with bottoms-up EV bridges (per-line conversion-probability-weighted customers x ARR x blended multiple) divided by future diluted share counts to capture dilution-to-breakeven. Stress-tested at a 45% failure weight; cross-checked vs an aggregate-equity dilution-haircut, a net-cash floor (after the $7M settlement claim), a raise-price sensitivity table, and a teardown of the lone HC Wainwright $60 bull target. Robust anchor = net cash (~$1.3) + thin option (~$1.3-2.2); $2.15 is the tail-inclusive expected value.
dossier.thesis_summary: Arqit is a near-pre-revenue (~$1.2M TTM) quantum-safe encryption company burning ~$50M/yr against ~$29M cash (less a $7M settlement due mid-2026), with real but architecturally-disadvantaged tech (it consumes the free, natively-shipping NIST PQC that is commoditizing its mainstream market), ZERO contracted revenue minimums, ~12 months runway, and an unresolved SEC investigation. Probability-weighted FMV ~$2.15/share over a ~$1.3 net-cash floor; critically, ex the 5% 'broad platform' tail the operating business is worth only ~$0.94 — BELOW its own cash. Against a $190.0M market cap (~$11.46/share; CEO sold at $13.51) the stock is ~80% overvalued. Rating: SELL/AVOID.
key_value_drivers: The 5% broad-platform tail contributes ~57% of fair value; ex-tail operating value (~$0.94) is below the net-cash floor — value is cash + a fragile option
ATM raise-clearing price: per-share niche-success value swings from ~$1.90 (raise at $4) to ~$3.01 (raise at $13)
Probability the defense/CSfC niche converts non-binding announcements into hard, contracted dollars (none contracted today; FY25 = 7 contracts, $530K)
Magnitude of the $80-150M dilution to fund ~$50M/yr burn to breakeven (16.6M -> ~30-45M shares)
Whether free native NIST PQC in AWS/Windows/Chrome/Cisco fully disintermediates the mainstream TAM
key_risks: Near-certain further equity dilution of $80-150M at potentially depressed prices (reflexive doom-loop)
~12 months gross cash runway, tightened by the $7M settlement cash-out ~mid-2026
Structural disintermediation by free, natively-shipped NIST PQC algorithms
Unresolved SEC fact-finding investigation into the Centricus SPAC projections; $7M securities-fraud settlement fully accrued (final hearing 1 June 2026)
Zero contracted revenue minimums in any disclosed deal (Intel TDX, Sparkle, DoD, RSG/Fabric, Vodafone)
Disclosure opacity: single segment, no customer concentration, lumpy point-in-time revenue
Short-side: thin float + 5.4M ITM warrants + 'quantum' theme = squeeze/borrow risk despite correct fundamentals
what_would_change_my_mind: A disclosed multi-year defense program of record with hard, multi-million-dollar contract value
A telco/enterprise converting a 'volume-defined license' into disclosed eight-figure recurring revenue
A strategic investment or partnership that removes the financing overhang
Formal closure of the SEC inquiry with no enforcement action
Confirming the bear: a dilutive raise at a depressed price, an SEC enforcement action, or flat revenue through FY2027

judge_gaps: The broad-platform tail probability (5%) and the niche/muddle splits remain irreducibly judgmental — a formal Monte Carlo over the probability and multiple distributions would quantify the FV's standard error rather than relying on discrete sensitivity cases (refinement, not a flaw; the author errs conservatively)
